name: Hans
source:
[i]Hans[/i] is a visual novel baking simulator in which you play as an alien dropped off on Earth during World War 1, who bakes magical pastries to help the people in your small town. You can also choose not to make what they ask for, because sometimes their requests are not as thought out as they may think. Just be prepared, because your actions have eight endings worth of consequences!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2671730/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]Hans[/i] 是一款视觉小说烘焙模拟器，你在其中扮演第一次世界大战期间降落在地球上的外星人，他烘焙神奇的糕点来帮助小镇上的人们。你也可以选择不满足他们的要求，因为有时他们的要求并不像他们想象的那么深思熟虑。请做好准备，因为你的行为会产生八个结局！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2671730/]Steam[/url]]
